sites.name: Global headquarters, One Dell Way
sites.description: Principal executive offices and global headquarters

source.label: Dell Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended January 30, 2026, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our principal executive offices and global headquarters are located at One Dell Way, Round Rock, Texas.

notes: Dell publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, sites, investment or taxes for FY2026. The FY2026 10-K gives approximately 97,000 employees as of January 30, 2026 (no geography). Item 2 gives floor space only as U.S. facilities (7.2 million sq ft owned, 1.0 leased) and international facilities (4.2 owned, 5.8 leased), as of January 30, 2026; that split is noted here, not recorded as rows. Owned manufacturing facilities are named only by country, not city ('We own manufacturing facilities located in the United States, Malaysia, China, Brazil, India, Poland, and Ireland'), so they are not listed as sites. Checked the FY2026 10-K and the FY26 'Impact by the Numbers' brief (delltechnologies.com, linked from Dell's ESG reports and resources page, checked 2026-11-24), which gives the same ~97,000 total with no geographic workforce data.
